podcast.title: Directives' Narratives
podcast.body: Executives from M.Y. were directly involved during the recordings of Sid Baret and contributed narratives to his biography, providing an insider's perspective on his time in the studio. "Tenemos aquí narraciones de directivos de M.Y. que estuvieron durante las grabaciones."

podcast.title: Reluctance to Sign Sid Baret for Solo Career
podcast.body: M.Y. Records was hesitant to back Sid Baret's solo career because, despite his talent, they considered him "crazy" and, more significantly, unpredictable. This made him a challenging artist for the label to manage for recording purposes. "Emmy no le gustaba nada en la idea de que Sid Baret volviese a trabajar porque a ver el vice-bale era un talento pero estaba como una cabra y sobre todo era impredecible."
